name: Sygg's Command
obligation: Select two Command modes: Merfolk copy, player team lifelink, draw, or target tap/stun.

name: Tam, Mindful First-Year
obligation: Other creatures gain hexproof from their own colors; tap ability temporarily sets own target to all colors.

name: Thoughtweft Lieutenant
obligation: Source or other Kithkin entry targets own creature for temporary boost/trample.

name: Trystan's Command
obligation: Two Command modes cover Elf copy, one/two graveyard permanents, destruction, or player-team boost and untap.

name: Twinflame Travelers
obligation: Another controlled Elemental's triggered ability generates an additional occurrence, including appropriate granted triggers.

name: Vibrance
obligation: Actual red/green spending enables damage and land tutor/life separately; alternative evoke sacrifice remains a trigger.

name: Voracious Tome-Skimmer
obligation: Opponent-turn spell trigger offers life payment before drawing.

name: Wary Farmer
obligation: End-step other-creature-entry history gates surveil with both trigger/resolution condition checks.

name: Wistfulness
obligation: Green/blue spending separately enables artifact/enchantment exile and draw/discard, with evoke sacrifice ordering.

name: Chronicle of Victory
obligation: Chosen type binds tribal power/keywords and any matching spell-cast draw, including noncreature kindred spells.

name: Dawn-Blessed Pennant
obligation: Choose among eight types; matching permanent entries gain life; mana/tap/sacrifice returns matching graveyard card.

name: Firdoch Core
obligation: Changeling kindred artifact produces chosen-color mana and animates without losing existing types.

name: Foraging Wickermaw
obligation: Entry surveils; once-per-turn generic filter produces chosen mana and changes source color until cleanup.

name: Gathering Stone
obligation: As-entry type choice scopes spell discount and recurring optional top-card reveal/hand or graveyard decisions.

name: Mirrormind Crown
obligation: First token creation each turn may become copies of current equipped creature; preserve optional replacement usage and copy snapshot.

name: Puca's Eye
obligation: Entry draw then chosen permanent color; draw activation requires all five colors among own permanents.

name: Springleaf Drum
obligation: Mana ability taps source and a controlled untapped creature; reserve both before chosen-color output.

name: Stalactite Dagger
obligation: Equipment creates changeling token and grants attached creature all types plus boost.

name: Blood Crypt
obligation: Swamp/Mountain land permits life payment on entry; external tapped entry remains tapped regardless.

name: Eclipsed Realms
obligation: Choose one of eight subtypes; unrestricted colorless or chosen-color mana restricted to chosen-type spell/ability source.

name: Evolving Wilds
obligation: Tap/sacrifice land tutors a basic onto battlefield tapped then shuffles.

name: Hallowed Fountain
obligation: Plains/Island land has optional entry life payment and two intrinsic mana choices.

name: Overgrown Tomb
obligation: Swamp/Forest land has optional entry life payment and two intrinsic mana choices.

name: Steam Vents
obligation: Island/Mountain land has optional entry life payment and two intrinsic mana choices.

name: Temple Garden
obligation: Forest/Plains land has optional entry life payment and two intrinsic mana choices.

name: Plains
obligation: Reuse Alpha Plains definition and intrinsic white mana; retain ECL format membership separately.

name: Island
obligation: Reuse Alpha Island definition and intrinsic blue mana; retain ECL format membership separately.

name: Swamp
obligation: Reuse Alpha Swamp definition and intrinsic black mana; retain ECL format membership separately.

name: Mountain
obligation: Reuse Alpha Mountain definition and intrinsic red mana; retain ECL format membership separately.

name: Forest
obligation: Reuse Alpha Forest definition and intrinsic green mana; retain ECL format membership separately.
